name: Asia Cement (China) Holdings Corp.
summary: Asia Cement (China) Holdings Corporation is an investment holding company headquartered in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong, and a subsidiary of Asia Cement Corporation. Through its cement and concrete segments, it makes and sells products in China such as Portland cement clinker, several grades of Portland cement, slag, limestone and ash powders, and ready-mix concrete. It also offers marketing and transport services and stores and sells cement products. It was incorporated in 2004.
